title: Import: {entity}
subtitle: Load records from Excel (.xlsx) or CSV with a check before importing
step1Hint: Headers in your language, an example row and a «Reference» sheet with allowed values. A template in any of the three languages works.
step2Hint: XLSX or CSV (UTF-8, «;» or «,» delimiter), up to {rows} rows and {mb} MB. We will show what will be imported first.
columnsHint: * — required column. Others may be left empty or removed.

options.duplicatesHint: By default, leads whose phone, Instagram or email matches an existing lead or client (or a row above in the file) are skipped.
options.create_clientsHint: If the client is not found by number or exact name, create a new client with this name.
options.create_tasksHint: For active projects, create tasks from the service template, as when a project is created automatically.

unknownColumns: These columns were not recognised and will be skipped: {columns}
confirmHint: Rows with errors and duplicates will be skipped, the rest will be imported.
done: Import finished: created {created}, duplicates skipped {skipped}, errors {errors}
alreadyImported: This file has already been imported — nothing was created again
expired: The file check has expired or was not found. Upload the file again.
inProgress: Import is running. Refresh the page in a minute.
moreRows: Rows not shown: {count}. Use the status filter.

rules.required: Columns with «*» are required. Headers may be in Uzbek, Russian or English.
rules.dates: Dates: YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY or an Excel date cell. Time: HH:MM, Tashkent time.
rules.numbers: Amounts may contain spaces and commas («9 000 000,50»). Currency — UZS (default) or USD.
rules.limits: No more than {rows} rows and {mb} MB; the first sheet is read.
rules.example: Delete the example row or replace it with your data: a row equal to the example is not imported.
rules.leadName: A contact name or a company is required; an empty lead title is built as on manual creation.
rules.leadContact: A phone or Telegram is required.
rules.leadDuplicates: Duplicates by phone (last 9 digits), Instagram or email among your leads and clients are skipped unless «Import duplicates too» is checked.
rules.leadVideo: For the «SMM video» source, give the number of a published video (V-00001) — otherwise the row is not imported.
rules.owner: Owner — email of an active manager or sales head within your scope. Empty — assigned as on manual creation.
rules.clientDuplicates: Clients with the same name, phone or email are skipped.
rules.dealClient: Client — number (C-00001) or exact name. Not found — a row error, or a new client if «Create clients» is checked.
rules.dealStage: Stage — any open stage. «Paid» and won deals are not imported: a deal becomes paid only when a payment is confirmed.
rules.usdRate: USD amounts are converted at today's rate; without a rate the row is not imported.
rules.projectDeal: Deal (D-00001) — a won deal of this client without a project. Empty — a won deal for the project price is created and marked as imported.
rules.projectNoPayments: Payments are neither created nor imported.
rules.projectRop: Sales head — email of a sales head or CEO. Only a user who sees all projects can assign another sales head.
rules.projectTasks: Tasks from the service template are created only with «Create tasks from template» checked.
rules.attendanceRoles: Attendance is tracked only for managers and sales heads. Employee — email or exact full name.
rules.attendanceTimes: Check-in and check-out — HH:MM; lateness and worked minutes are calculated from the schedule. Future dates are not accepted.
rules.attendanceUpsert: If a record for that day already exists, it is replaced.

projects.dealComment: The deal was created by a project import as won, without payments.

reasons.exampleRow: Example row from the template — not imported
reasons.duplicateInFile: Duplicate of row {row} of this file
reasons.duplicateInFileImported: Similar to row {row}, imported because «Import duplicates too» is checked.
reasons.duplicateImported: Possible duplicate ({list}), imported because «Import duplicates too» is checked.
reasons.clientFromEarlierRow: The client will be created from a row above.
reasons.dealWillBeCreated: A won deal without payments will be created.
reasons.projectExists: The client already has a project with this name: {project}
reasons.attendanceUpdate: A record for this day already exists — it will be replaced.

errors.fileType: An Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file is required
errors.fileSize: The file is larger than {mb} MB
errors.unreadable: Could not read the file. Save it in Excel as .xlsx and upload again.
errors.noHeader: The file has no header row
errors.noRows: The file has no data rows
errors.tooManyRows: Too many rows: no more than {max} at a time
errors.missingColumns: Required columns are missing: {columns}. Download the template.
errors.noKnownColumns: No column was recognised. Download the template.
errors.tooLong: Value of «{column}» is too long (no more than {max} characters)
errors.date: Invalid date in «{column}»: {value}. Use YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY
errors.notInList: Value «{value}» in column «{column}» is not in the reference list
errors.ownerRole: {email}: only a manager or sales head can be the owner
errors.ownerScope: {email}: the employee is outside your scope — cannot be assigned as owner
errors.ropScope: {email}: only a user who sees all projects can assign another sales head to a project
errors.clientNotFound: Client «{value}» was not found among clients available to you
errors.clientAmbiguous: Several clients are named «{value}» — give the number (C-00001)
errors.contactName: Give the contact name (other contact fields are filled)
errors.stagePaid: The «Paid» stage and won deals are not imported — a deal becomes paid only when a payment is confirmed
errors.dealNotFound: Deal {value} was not found among deals available to you
errors.dealNotWon: Deal {deal} is not won — a project is created after the deal is paid
errors.priceRequired: Give the price: the project deal is created with it
errors.employeeNotFound: Employee «{value}» was not found among employees available to you
errors.employeeAmbiguous: Several employees named «{value}» — give the email
errors.futureDate: The date is in the future — attendance is entered only for past days and today
errors.statusRequired: Give a status or a check-in time
errors.timesForAbsence: Check-in and check-out times are given only for the «Present» and «Late» statuses
errors.notFoundOrScope: Record not found or outside your scope
errors.unexpected: The row could not be imported because of an internal error
